description.p: This is a community package of Flectar Mail, maintained independently and unaffiliated with its developer. It repackages the official upstream Linux release (.deb) unmodified and follows upstream releases automatically.

Flectar Mail is a native Rust and Slint mail client with offline-first storage, Gmail and Microsoft account support, contacts, and calendars. It is built for speed: instant startup and a small memory footprint at idle.

Permissions: this package grants the display, the GPU, network access, the Secret Service (where account passwords and tokens are stored), the tray and the dock's unread-count service. Links and attachments go through the desktop portals, so the app has no access to your files beyond those you pick.
